verses: Haa Meem
Uss kitab ka utarna Allah Taalaa ghalib hikmat walay ki taraf say hai

Hum ney aasmano aur zamin aur unn dono kay darmiyan ki tamam cheezon ko behtareen tadbeer kay sath hi aik muddat moyyen kay liye peda kiya hai, aur kafir log jiss cheez say daraye jatay hain mun mor letay hain

Aap keh dijiye! bhala dekho to jinhen tum Allah kay siwa pukartay ho mujhay bhi to dikhao kay unhon ney zamin ka kaun sa tukra banaya hai ya aasmano mein unn ka kaun sa hissa hai? Agar tum sachay ho to uss say pehlay hi ki koi kitab ya koi ilm hi jo naqal kiya jata ho, meray pass lao
Aur uss say barh ker gumrah aur kaun hoga? Jo Allah kay siwa aison ko pukarta hai jo qayamat tak uss ki dua qabool na ker saken balkay)yeh unn kay pukarney say mehaz bey-khabar hun
Aur jab logon ko jama kiya jaye ga to yeh unn kay dushman ho jayen gay aur unn ki parastish say saaf inkar ker jayen gay
Aur unhen jab humari wazeh aayaten parh ker sunaee jati hain to munkir log sachi baat ko jab kay unn kay pass chuki, keh detay hain kay yeh to sareeh jadoo hai

Kiya woh kehtay hain kay ussay to uss ney khud gharr liya hai aap keh dijiye! kay agar mein hi ussay bana laya hun to tum meray liye Allah ki taraf say kissi cheez ka ikhtiyar nahi rakhtay, tum uss (Quran) kay baray mein jo kuch keh sunn rahey ho ussay Allah khoob janta hai, meray aur tumharay darmiyan gawahi kay liye o hi kafi hai, aur woh bakhshney wala meharban hai

Aap keh dijiye! kay mein koi bilkul anokha payghumbar to nahi na mujhay yeh maloom hai kay meray sath aur tumharay sath kiya kiya jaye ga. Mein to sirf ussi ki pairwee kerta hun jo meri taraf wahee bheji jati hai aur mein to sirf elan aagah ker denay wala hun

Aap keh dijiye! agar yeh (Quran) Allah hi ki taraf say ho aur tum ney ussay na mana ho aur bani israeel ka aik gawah uss jaisi ki gawahi bhi dey chuka ho aur woh eman bhi chuka ho aur tum ney sirkashi ki ho, to be-shak Allah Taalaa zalimon ko raah nahi dikhata

Aur kafiron ney eman daron ki nisbat kaha kay agar yeh (deen) behtar hota to yeh log uss ki taraf hum say sabqat kerney na patay, aur chunkay unhon ney Quran say hidayat nahi paee pus yeh keh den gay kay qadeemi jhoot hai
Aur uss say pehlay Musa ki kitab paishwa aur rehmat thi. Aur yeh kitab hai tasdeeq kerney wali arabi zaban mein takay zalimon ko daraye aur nek kaaron ko bisharat ho
Be-shak jin logon ney kaha kay humara rab Allah hai phir uss per jamay rahey to unn per na to koi khof hoga aur na ghumgeen hun gay
Yeh to ahl jannat hain jo sada ussi mein rahen gay, unn aemaal kay badlay jo woh kiya kertay thay

Aur hum ney insan ko apney maa baap kay sath husn-o-khoobi salook kerney ka hukum diya hai, uss ki maa ney ussay takleef jhel ker pet mein rakha aur takleef bardasht kerkay ussay jana. Uss kay hamal ka aur uss kay doodh churaney ka zamaney tees maheeney ka hai. Yahan tak kay jab woh pukhtagi aur chalees saal ki umar ko phoncha to kehney laga aey meray perwerdigar! mujhay tofiq dey kay mein teri uss nemat ka shukar baja laon jo tu ney mujh per aur meray maa baap per inam ki hai aur yeh kay mein aisay nek amal keroon jin say to khush ho jaye aur to meri aulad bhi saleh bana, mein teri taraf rujoo kerta hun aur mein musalmanon mein say hun

Yehi woh log hain jin kay nek aemaal to hum qabool farma letay hain aur jin kay bad aemaal say darguzar ker letay hain, (yeh) jannati logon mein hain. Uss sachay waday kay mutabiq jo unn say kiya jata tha

Aur jiss ney apney maa baap say kaha kay tum say mein tang aagaya, tum mujh say yehi kehtay raho gay kay mein marney kay baad phir zindah kiya jaon ga mujh say pehlay bhi ummaten guzar chuki hain, woh dono janab bari mein faryad kertay hain aur kehtay hain tujhay kharabi ho to eman ley aa, be-shak Allah ka wada haq hai, woh jawab deta hai kay yeh to sirf aglon kay afsaney hain
Woh log hain jin per (Allah kay azab ka) wada sadiq aagaya, unn jinnat aur insano kay girohon kay sath jo unn say pehlay guzar chukay hain, yaqeenan yeh nuksan paney walay thay
Aur her aik ko apney apney aemaal kay mutabiq darjay milen gay takay unhen unn kay aemaal kay pooray badlay dey aur unn per zulm na kiya jaye ga

Aur jiss din kafir jahannum kay siray per laye jayen gay (kaha jaye ga) tum ney apni nekiyan duniya ki zindagi mein hi barbaad ker den aur unn say faeeday utha chukay, pus aaj tumhen zillat kay azab ki saza di jaye gi, uss baees kay tum zamin mein na-haq takabbur kiya kertay thay aur uss baees bhi kay tum hukum adooli kiya kertay thay

Aur aad kay bhai ko yaad kero, jabkay uss ney apni qom ko aahqaaf mein daraya aur yaqeenan uss say pehlay bhi daraney walay guzar chukay hain aur uss kay baad bhi yeh kay tum siwaye Allah Taalaa kay aur kissi ki ibadat na kero, be-shak mein tum per baray din kay azab say khof khata hun

Qom ney jawab diya, kiya aap humaray pass uss liye aaye hain kay humen apney maboodon (ki parastish) say baaz rakhen? Pus agar aap sachay hain to jiss azab ka aap wada kertay hain ussay hum per laa dalen
(hazrat Hood ney) kaha (uss ka) ilm to Allah hi kay pass hai, mein to jo paygham dey ker bheja gaya tha woh tumhen phoncha raha hun lekin mein dekhta hun kay tum log nadani ker rahey ho

Phir jab unhon ney azab ko basoorat badal dekha apni wadiyon ki taraf aatay huye to kehney lagay, yeh abar hum per barasney wala hai, (nahi) balkay)yeh dar-asal yeh abar woh (azab) hai jiss ki tum jaldi ker rahey thay, hua hai jiss mein dard-naak azab hai
Jo apney rab kay hukum say her cheez ko halak ker dey gi, pus woh aisay hogaye kay bajuz unn kay makanaat kay aur kuch dikhaee na deta tha. Gunehgaron kay giroh ko hum yun hi saza detay hain

Aur bil-yaqeen hum ney (qom aad) ko woh maqdoor diye thay jo tumhen to diye bhi nahi aur hum ney unhen kaan aankhen aur dil bhi dey rakhay thay. Lekin unn kay kanon aur aankhon aur dilon ney unhen kuch bhi nafa na phonchaya jabkay woh Allah Taalaa ki aayaton ka inkar kerney lagay aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uraya kertay thay o hi unn per ulat pari
Aur yaqeenan hum ney tumharay aas pass ki bastiyan tabah ker den aur tarah tarah ki hum ney apni nishaniyan biyan ker den takay woh rujoo ker len

Pus qurb elahi hasil kerney kay liye unhon ney Allah kay siwa jin jin ko apna mabood bana rakha tha unhon ney unn ki madad kiyon na ki? Balkay)yeh woh to unn say kho gaye, (balkay)yeh dar-asal) yeh unn ka mehaz jhoot aur (bilkul) bohtan tha

Aur yaad kero! jabkay hum ney jinno ki aik jamat ko teri taraf mutawajha kiya kay woh Quran sunen, pus jab (nabi kay) pass phonch gaye to (aik doosray say) kehney lagay khamosh ho jao, phir jab parh ker khatam hogaya to apni qom ko khabardaar kerney kay liye wapis lot gaye

Kehney lagay aey humari qom! hum ney yaqeenan woh kitab suni hai jo Musa (alaihi as-salam) kay baad nazil ki gaee hai jo apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerney wali hai jo sachay deen ki aur raah raast ki taraf rehnumaee kerti hai
Aey humari qom! Allah kay bulanay walay ka kaha mano, uss per eman lao, to Allah tumharay gunah bakhsh dey ga aur tumhen alamnaak azab say panah dey ga

Aur jo shakhs Allah kay bulanay walay ka kaha na manay ga pus woh zamin mein kahen (bhaag ker Allah ko) aajiz nahi ker sakta, na Allah kay siwa aur koi uss kay madad gaar hun gay, yeh log khulli gumrahi mein hain

Kiya woh nahi dekhtay kay jiss Allah ney aasmano aur zamin ko peda kiya aur unn kay peda kerney say woh na thaka, woh yaqeenan mardon ko zindah kerney per qadir hai? Kiyon na ho? Woh yaqeenan her cheez per qadir hai

Woh log jinhon ney kufur kiya jiss din jahannum kay samney laye jayen gay (aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay) kiya yeh haq nahi hai? To jawab den gay kay haan qasam hai humaray rab ki (haq hai) (Allah) farmaye ga, abb apney kufur kay badlay azab ka maza chakho

Pus (aey payghumbar!) tum aisa sabar kero jaisa sabar aali himmat rasoolon ney kiya aur unn kay liye (azab talab kerney mein) jaldi na kero, yeh jiss din uss azab ko dekh len gay jiss ka wada diye jatay hain to (yeh maloom honey lagay ga kay) din ki aik ghari hi (duniya mein) thehray thay, yeh hai paygham phoncha dena, pus badkaron kay siwa koi halak na kiya jaye ga
